findings.summary: Legacy peer must advertise older-only versions; default options negotiate 2026-07-28 and the legacy gate never fires.
T2 validation embeds a plausibly-red out-of-envelope pre-existing test; bound the command or state a verified-green precondition.
AC02-2/AC03-2 zero-tools/list oracles need a pinned counting window.
Section 3 overstates Mcp-Method coverage; standard headers are new-protocol-only.
Anchor and wording nits: config field range, logging-contract table range, refresh completion sentence.
Warm cost claim must state the paginated worst case.

Modern test peer pinned to 2026-07-28 is a stateful handler; go-sdk only supports >=2026-07-28 on stateless transports, so the modern session falls back to legacy and AC01-1 RED/GREEN is unattainable.
Anchor residue: config.go :41, core.go:245-262, runtime.go:184-233.
Focused -run patterns omit TestStatefulHeaderParameterToolSucceeds and TestLegacyProtocolHeaderParameterToolFailsWithNamedCode.
serve_upstream_restart_test.go range :155-260 includes TestUpstreamEphemeralHandshakeLog; cite :155-218.
AC01-4 and AC03-1 control asserts exactly one initialize; a modern session completes via server discover and sends none.
AC02-1 pagination fixture assumes registration order; the list orders by tool name, so the header tool must sort after the others.
Prepare failures are not all not_started: failureOutcome maps deadline and cancel to deadline_exceeded or internal_error.
Index swaps before catalog publication; a removed tool can stay published while absent from the index.
R5 zero-definition clause has no oracle; needs a positive-TTL fixture counting list RPCs.
AC03-3 oracle greps two strings only; does not verify R7 mechanism, operator action or cost.
T1 allowed scope omits peer-response capture required by AC01-2.
R2 remains absolute while I2 admits one interval of catalog under-inclusion; a design invariant may not narrow a requirement.
R1 and R5 exactly-one-execution property has no oracle; AC02-1 and AC03-1 do not assert the peer recorded exactly one tools call.
Stale anchor: wiring.go:142 should be the facade at wiring.go:177-178.
Stale anchor: go.mod:11 should be go.mod:8 for go-sdk v1.8.0.
Sequence line says admission then connect; Dedicated.CallTool connects before ServerClient.CallTool admits.
Timeout and range wording: stateless connect uses the parent context; put is client.go:1276 and sortKeys is features.go:100-104.
Startup publishes the durable-snapshot catalog before discovery, so the header-bound index is empty while header-bound tools are published; I2 at-every-instant and R2 absolute are false at startup.
findings.fix: Initialize the annotation index from the durable snapshot (or withhold header-bound catalog entries until discovery completes) so no published header-bound tool lacks an index entry at startup.

findings.summary: Union install never prunes, so a de-annotated tool keeps its index entry for the process lifetime and body-only calls pay a definitions pass, contradicting R3 and the stated cost bound; no AC covers de-annotation.
findings.fix: Install union(header-bound names of the previously published catalog, new discovery set) to prune, or scope R3 and add a de-annotation oracle.
